probe_meta.label: dense-G (controlled retrieval-mechanism swap of Probe G)

response_text:
1. (Currently Amended) A lamp comprised of an at least substantially hollow columnar body, a plurality of light emitting diodes disposed on said columnar body, a plurality of fins disposed on said columnar body, a base member disposed at a first end of the columnar body and providing a means for electrical connection, __an electronics module disposed within the columnar body and in electrical communication with the base member, and a light dispersing optic element overlapping said diodes__.

2. (Previously presented) The lamp of claim 1 wherein a second end of said columnar body is open.

3. (Cancelled)

4. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim __1__ wherein said optic element includes a phosphor material.

5. (Previously presented) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said diodes are substantially evenly spaced radially around the columnar body.

6. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 5 wherein said fins are substantially equally disposed between said diodes __and said optic element preferentially directs light substantially perpendicular to an elongated axis of the columnar body__.

7. (Previously presented) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body comprises one of a tetragon, pentagon, hexagon, heptagon, octagon, nonagon, decagon, hendecagon, or dodecagon in cross-section.

8. (Previously presented) The lamp of claim 7 wherein at least one diode resides on each face of said columnar body.

9. (Previously presented) The lamp of claim 8 wherein one fin resides on each corner of said columnar body.

10. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 9 wherein a single diode resides on each face __and said electronics module comprises a printed circuit board including circuitry for converting AC to DC current__.

11. (Previously presented) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body and said fins are comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK.

12. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 9 __wherein__ a single optic element is disposed between each adjacent fin overlapping said diode __and said electronics module comprises a printed circuit board including circuitry for converting AC to DC current__.

13. (Previously presented) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said base member comprises an Edison screw base or a wedge base.

14. (Cancelled)

15. (Cancelled)

16. (Currently Amended) A lamp comprising an elongated hollow polygonal body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK, a fin extending radially from each corner of said body, a light emitting diode mounted to each side of said body, a screw or wedge base connector closing a first end of said body, a second end of said body being open, an electronics module disposed within said body in electrical communication with said connector and said light emitting diodes, __a light dispersing optic element overlapping said light emitting diodes,__ said lamp having a general A19 outline.

17. (Currently Amended) A method of manufacturing a lamp comprising extruding an elongated hollow body, said body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK, cutting said body to a predetermined length, attaching at least one light emitting diode to said body__, attaching a light dispersing optic element overlapping said light emitting diode,__ and providing electrical circuitry suitable for powering said light emitting diode.

18. (Previously presented) The method of claim 17 wherein said material has a thermal conductivity greater than about 150 W/mK.

19. (Previously presented) The method of claim 17 wherein said body includes a plurality of integral radially extending fins.

20. (Currently Amended) The method of claim __17__ wherein said body has substantially straight side walls.
